name: Eagles
overview: Scripture uses the image of eagles to illustrate God's care, strength, and renewal for His people. God carries His people on eagles' wings, lifting them up and protecting them, as seen in Exodus 19:4 and Deuteronomy 32:11, where the eagle’s nurturing and protective nature is highlighted. The eagle’s soaring flight and keen vision symbolize renewal and strength, as Psalm 103:5 compares the renewal of youth to the eagle’s vigor. Additionally, Proverbs 30:19 reflects on the mysterious and purposeful ways of the eagle, emphasizing God’s wisdom in creation.
